mapper.sql: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, detail, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.entity_type, a.entity_id, a.action, a.actor_id, COALESCE(u.name, CONCAT('用户#', a.actor_id)) AS actor_name, d.name AS department_name, a.detail, DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM fin_audit a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.actor_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id=u.department_id
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
